source_claim: The official TV anime character directory identifies these named characters under its U.A. student character directory category and carries the My Hero Academia production copyright.
notes: The official character directory directly names Tamaki Amajiki, Nejire Hado, and Mei Hatsume on a page headed CHARACTER and carries the My Hero Academia production copyright. These exact current campaign keys correspond to 天喰環, 波動ねじれ, and 発目明. The grouping or shared school is not used as the authority basis; the production’s character directory itself is.
